mapper.select: SELECT FROM task_publication_judgement WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM task_publication_judgement WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND task_id IN #{taskId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_publication_judgement WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_publication_judgement (workspace_id, task_id, judged_state, effective_on, judge_reason, judged_by_user_id, judged_by_name, judged_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{taskId}, #{judgedState}, #{effectiveOn}, #{judgeReason}, #{judgedByUserId}, #{judgedByName}, COALESCE(#{judgedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)))
mapper.update: UPDATE task_publication_judgement SET revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), revoked_by_user_id = #{revokedByUserId}, revoked_by_name = #{revokedByName}, revoke_reason = #{revokeReason} WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
